_comment: Canonical wiring from meta/mcp_hub (snippets/n8n-mcp.mcp.json). Docs-only mode: the 7 core tools (node docs, search, validation, templates) work with no credentials. N8N_API_URL is pre-pointed at the local dev instance; add N8N_API_KEY to unlock the 13 management tools. Per the run-n8n harness, the key is obtained from the n8n UI on first launch and cataloged through weave — do NOT commit a key here (public repo).
